_doc: Farmer buildings (docs/hvf-PLAN.md §6). Read by js/sim/modes/hvf/farm.js. size = footprint in 2 m cells [w, d]; cost in gold, each further copy of the same building by the same farmer x copyMult; makes = animal kind and capacity (cap) for producers; flat = gold/s without animals; incomePct = added to all the farmer's income; tell 0-3 (how loud: shown in the build menu); hp. Gold is the only gate: no build timers, no tech locks. A building is placed when its farmer reaches it (buildRange in units.json) and still has the gold. `blocks`: who cannot walk through its cells (all = everyone and animals; hunters = hunters and army only).

barn.name: Cow Barn
barn.desc: Two cows. Big, slow and easy to spot.

windmill.desc: +35% to all your income. Tall: seen over the trees.

hedge.desc: Farmers and animals squeeze through; hunters cannot.
